-- Migración: Sistema de Reportes Automáticos por Email
-- Fecha: 2026-02-24

-- Tabla de configuración de reportes programados
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `scheduled_reports` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `report_name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `report_type` ENUM('monthly', 'quarterly', 'annual') NOT NULL,
  `recipients` JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Array de emails destinatarios',
  `include_nmx025` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  `include_nom035` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  `include_cases` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  `is_active` BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  `created_by` INT NOT NULL,
  `created_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_report_type` (`report_type`),
  INDEX `idx_is_active` (`is_active`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- Tabla de historial de envíos de reportes
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `report_history` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `report_id` INT NOT NULL,
  `sent_at` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `sent_by` INT NOT NULL,
  `recipient_count` INT NOT NULL,
  `status` ENUM('sent', 'failed', 'pending') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `metrics_snapshot` JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Snapshot de métricas enviadas',
  INDEX `idx_report_id` (`report_id`),
  INDEX `idx_sent_at` (`sent_at`),
  INDEX `idx_status` (`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
